ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course is for EOL EdM and CAS students whose cohort began Spr 2008. The course begins Aug 22 and ends Nov 15. Class sessions will be held at the West Side Technical Institute on the following four weekends: Aug 22 and 23, Sep 26 and 27, Oct 17 and 18, and Nov 14 and 15. The four Friday evening sessions will be held from 5:00 to 9:00 PM, and Saturday sessions will be held from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC or EDM:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $441.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
